links.outcome: Hallucination frequency in GPT-4 node-level reasoning on neurology notes
links.effect: Hallucinations occurred in 32 cases (26%), most commonly incoherence (75%) and overreliance (47%).
links.quote: Hallucinations occurred in 32 cases (26%), most commonly incoherence (75%) and overreliance (47%).

unlisted_practices: Converting diagnostic criteria (2017 McDonald) into a decision tree to structure LLM reasoning with expert-curated knowledge at each node

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-guided decision tree framework retrospectively on clinical notes for diagnosing multiple sclerosis and characterizes hallucination rates, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
